source: ABIM Laboratory Test Reference Ranges - January 2026

interpretation.low: Anemia - may indicate iron deficiency, chronic disease, or blood loss
interpretation.high: Polycythemia - may indicate dehydration or bone marrow disorder

interpretation.low: Anemia - investigate for causes
interpretation.high: Polycythemia - may need further evaluation

interpretation.low: Low hematocrit. May indicate anemia, blood loss, or overhydration.
interpretation.high: Elevated hematocrit. May indicate dehydration or polycythemia.

interpretation.low: Low hematocrit. May indicate anemia, blood loss, or overhydration.
interpretation.high: Elevated hematocrit. May indicate dehydration or polycythemia.

interpretation.low: Low RBC. May indicate anemia or bone marrow suppression.
interpretation.high: Elevated RBC. May indicate polycythemia or chronic hypoxia.

interpretation.low: Low RBC. May indicate anemia or bone marrow suppression.
interpretation.high: Elevated RBC. May indicate polycythemia or chronic hypoxia.

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. White blood cell count is appropriate.
interpretation.low: Leukopenia; may indicate bone marrow suppression, viral infection, or immunodeficiency.
interpretation.high: Leukocytosis; may indicate infection, inflammation, or hematologic disorder.

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. Platelet count is adequate for hemostasis.
interpretation.low: Thrombocytopenia; increased bleeding risk. Evaluate for bone marrow, immune, or consumptive causes.
interpretation.high: Thrombocytosis; may indicate reactive process, iron deficiency, or myeloproliferative disorder.

interpretation.low: Low MCV (microcytosis). May indicate iron deficiency anemia or thalassemia.
interpretation.high: Elevated MCV (macrocytosis). May indicate B12/folate deficiency, liver disease, or myelodysplasia.

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. Mean corpuscular hemoglobin is appropriate.
interpretation.low: Hypochromia; suggests iron deficiency or thalassemia trait.
interpretation.high: Hyperchromia; may indicate macrocytic anemia (B12/folate deficiency).

interpretation.low: Low MCHC. May indicate iron deficiency or thalassemia.
interpretation.high: Elevated MCHC. May indicate spherocytosis.

interpretation.low: Below normal range
interpretation.high: Elevated RDW. May indicate mixed anemias, iron deficiency, or B12/folate deficiency.

interpretation.low: Low fasting glucose (hypoglycemia). May indicate excessive insulin, fasting, or adrenal insufficiency.
interpretation.high: Elevated fasting glucose. 100-125 mg/dL indicates prediabetes, ≥126 mg/dL indicates diabetes.

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. Random glucose is within expected range.
interpretation.low: Hypoglycemia; evaluate for medication effects, insulinoma, or adrenal insufficiency.
interpretation.high: Elevated random glucose; may indicate impaired glucose tolerance or diabetes mellitus.

interpretation.low: Below normal range
interpretation.high: Elevated HbA1c. 5.7-6.4% indicates prediabetes, ≥6.5% indicates diabetes mellitus.

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. Blood urea nitrogen reflects normal renal function and hydration.
interpretation.low: Low BUN; may indicate liver disease, malnutrition, or overhydration.
interpretation.high: Elevated BUN; may indicate renal impairment, dehydration, or high protein intake.

interpretation.low: Below normal. May indicate reduced muscle mass.
interpretation.high: Elevated creatinine. May indicate impaired kidney function.

interpretation.low: Below normal. May indicate reduced muscle mass.
interpretation.high: Elevated creatinine. May indicate impaired kidney function.

interpretation.low: Low uric acid. May indicate Fanconi syndrome or Wilson disease.
interpretation.high: Elevated uric acid (hyperuricemia). May indicate gout risk, kidney disease, or increased cell turnover.

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. Serum sodium concentration is appropriate.
interpretation.low: Hyponatremia; may indicate fluid overload, SIADH, or adrenal insufficiency.
interpretation.high: Hypernatremia; may indicate dehydration, diabetes insipidus, or excessive sodium intake.

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. Serum potassium is within safe range.
interpretation.low: Hypokalemia; risk of cardiac arrhythmia. Evaluate diuretic use, GI losses, or renal wasting.
interpretation.high: Hyperkalemia; risk of cardiac conduction abnormalities. Evaluate renal function and medications.

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. Serum chloride is appropriate.
interpretation.low: Hypochloremia; may indicate metabolic alkalosis, vomiting, or diuretic use.
interpretation.high: Hyperchloremia; may indicate metabolic acidosis, dehydration, or renal tubular acidosis.

interpretation.low: Low bicarbonate. May indicate metabolic acidosis.
interpretation.high: Elevated bicarbonate. May indicate metabolic alkalosis or chronic respiratory acidosis.

interpretation.low: Low calcium (hypocalcemia). May indicate hypoparathyroidism, vitamin D deficiency, or chronic kidney disease.
interpretation.high: Elevated calcium (hypercalcemia). May indicate hyperparathyroidism, malignancy, or excessive vitamin D.

interpretation.low: Low magnesium (hypomagnesemia). May indicate malabsorption, alcoholism, or diuretic use.
interpretation.high: Elevated magnesium (hypermagnesemia). May indicate renal failure or excessive intake.

interpretation.low: Low phosphorus (hypophosphatemia). May indicate malnutrition, vitamin D deficiency, or hyperparathyroidism.
interpretation.high: Elevated phosphorus (hyperphosphatemia). May indicate renal failure or hypoparathyroidism.

interpretation.low: Low total protein. May indicate malnutrition, liver disease, or nephrotic syndrome.
interpretation.high: Elevated total protein. May indicate chronic inflammation, multiple myeloma, or dehydration.

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. Serum albumin reflects adequate hepatic synthetic function and nutrition.
interpretation.low: Hypoalbuminemia; may indicate liver disease, nephrotic syndrome, malnutrition, or inflammation.
interpretation.high: Elevated albumin; typically seen with dehydration.

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. Serum globulin is appropriate.
interpretation.low: Low globulin; may indicate immune deficiency (hypogammaglobulinemia).
interpretation.high: Elevated globulin; may indicate chronic inflammation, infection, or myeloma.

interpretation.low: Below normal range
interpretation.high: Elevated total bilirubin. May indicate liver disease, hemolysis, or bile duct obstruction.

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. Direct (conjugated) bilirubin is appropriate.
interpretation.low: Below expected range; generally not clinically significant.
interpretation.high: Elevated direct bilirubin; suggests hepatobiliary obstruction or conjugated hyperbilirubinemia.

interpretation.low: Below normal range
interpretation.high: Elevated indirect bilirubin. May indicate hemolysis or Gilbert syndrome.

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. AST level is appropriate.
interpretation.low: Below expected range; generally not clinically significant.
interpretation.high: Elevated AST; may indicate hepatocellular injury, myocardial damage, or muscle injury.

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. ALT level is appropriate.
interpretation.low: Below expected range; generally not clinically significant.
interpretation.high: Elevated ALT; may indicate hepatocellular injury. More liver-specific than AST.

interpretation.low: Low ALP. May indicate hypothyroidism, anemia, or zinc deficiency.
interpretation.high: Elevated ALP. May indicate liver disease, bile duct obstruction, or bone disease.

interpretation.low: Below normal range
interpretation.high: Elevated GGT. May indicate liver disease, bile duct obstruction, or alcohol use.

interpretation.low: Below normal range
interpretation.high: Elevated GGT. May indicate liver disease, bile duct obstruction, or alcohol use.

interpretation.low: Below normal range
interpretation.high: Elevated LDH. May indicate tissue damage, hemolysis, liver disease, or malignancy.
Borderline high (200-239), High (≥240)

interpretation.low: Low HDL increases cardiovascular risk
Low HDL increases cardiovascular risk

interpretation.high: Near optimal (100-129), Borderline high (130-159), High (160-189), Very high (≥190)

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. VLDL cholesterol is within desirable range.
interpretation.high: Elevated VLDL; associated with increased cardiovascular risk and hypertriglyceridemia.
Borderline high (150-199), High (200-499), Very high (≥500)

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. Thyroid function appears normal.
interpretation.low: Below reference range. May indicate hyperthyroidism or thyroid suppression.
interpretation.high: Above reference range. May indicate hypothyroidism. Consider free T4 testing.

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. Total T4 reflects adequate thyroid hormone production.
interpretation.low: Low total T4; may indicate hypothyroidism. Correlate with TSH and free T4.
interpretation.high: Elevated total T4; may indicate hyperthyroidism or TBG elevation. Correlate with TSH.

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. Free T4 reflects adequate unbound thyroid hormone.
interpretation.low: Low free T4; suggests hypothyroidism. Correlate with TSH.
interpretation.high: Elevated free T4; suggests hyperthyroidism. Correlate with TSH.

interpretation.low: Low T3. May indicate hypothyroidism, nonthyroidal illness, or malnutrition.
interpretation.high: Elevated T3. May indicate hyperthyroidism.

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. Free T3 is appropriate.
interpretation.low: Low free T3; may indicate hypothyroidism or non-thyroidal illness (sick euthyroid).
interpretation.high: Elevated free T3; may indicate hyperthyroidism, particularly T3 thyrotoxicosis.

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. Serum iron is appropriate.
interpretation.low: Low serum iron; may indicate iron deficiency, chronic disease, or malabsorption.
interpretation.high: Elevated serum iron; may indicate hemochromatosis, iron supplementation, or hemolysis.

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. Total iron-binding capacity is appropriate.
interpretation.low: Low TIBC; may indicate chronic disease, malnutrition, or iron overload.
interpretation.high: Elevated TIBC; typically seen in iron deficiency anemia.

interpretation.low: Low ferritin. Indicates iron deficiency.
interpretation.high: Elevated ferritin. May indicate iron overload, inflammation, or liver disease.

interpretation.low: Low ferritin. Indicates iron deficiency.
interpretation.high: Elevated ferritin. May indicate iron overload, inflammation, or liver disease.

interpretation.low: Low B12. May indicate deficiency due to malabsorption, pernicious anemia, or vegan diet.
interpretation.high: Elevated B12. May indicate liver disease or myeloproliferative disorder.

interpretation.low: Low vitamin D. May indicate deficiency; risk for osteoporosis and bone disease.
interpretation.high: Elevated vitamin D. May indicate excessive supplementation; risk of toxicity.

interpretation.low: Low folate. May indicate folate deficiency, malabsorption, or increased demand (pregnancy).
interpretation.high: Elevated folate. Usually not clinically significant.
Elevated PSA. Further evaluation needed; may indicate prostate conditions.
interpretation.normal: PSA level noted. No specific normal or abnormal level per ABIM.
Within normal limits. Erythrocyte sedimentation rate is not elevated.
interpretation.low: Below expected range; generally not clinically significant.
interpretation.high: Elevated ESR; non-specific marker of inflammation, infection, or malignancy.

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. Erythrocyte sedimentation rate is not elevated.
interpretation.low: Below expected range; generally not clinically significant.
interpretation.high: Elevated ESR; non-specific marker of inflammation, infection, or malignancy.
Elevated CRP. May indicate acute inflammation, infection, tissue injury, or autoimmune disease.
interpretation.normal: Within normal limits, low inflammation risk

interpretation.low: Below normal. Uncommon; may indicate hypercoagulability.
interpretation.high: Prolonged PT. May indicate vitamin K deficiency, liver disease, DIC, or warfarin effect.

interpretation.low: Below normal. May indicate hypercoagulability.
interpretation.high: Elevated INR. May indicate bleeding risk, vitamin K deficiency, liver disease, or anticoagulant effect.

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. Activated partial thromboplastin time is appropriate.
interpretation.low: Shortened aPTT; may indicate hypercoagulable state.
interpretation.high: Prolonged aPTT; may indicate heparin effect, factor deficiency, or lupus anticoagulant.

interpretation.low: Low fibrinogen. May indicate DIC, liver disease, or fibrinolysis.
interpretation.high: Elevated fibrinogen. May indicate inflammation, infection, or increased thrombotic risk.

interpretation.low: Below normal range
interpretation.high: Elevated ammonia. May indicate liver dysfunction, hepatic encephalopathy, or urea cycle disorders.

interpretation.low: Low amylase. May indicate chronic pancreatitis with pancreatic insufficiency.
interpretation.high: Elevated amylase. May indicate acute pancreatitis, salivary gland inflammation, or intestinal obstruction.

interpretation.low: Below normal range
interpretation.high: Elevated lipase. May indicate acute pancreatitis, pancreatic disease, or abdominal pathology.
Heart failure likely if >400, intermediate 100-400

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. Troponin I is below the upper reference limit.
interpretation.high: Elevated troponin I; may indicate myocardial injury. Evaluate for acute coronary syndrome.

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. Troponin T is below the upper reference limit.
interpretation.high: Elevated troponin T; may indicate myocardial injury. Evaluate for acute coronary syndrome.

interpretation.low: eGFR 60-89: Mildly decreased kidney function (CKD Stage G2). Monitor annually if risk factors present.
interpretation.high: Within normal limits.
interpretation.critical_low: eGFR <15: Kidney failure (CKD Stage G5). Urgent nephrology referral and dialysis evaluation required.

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. Urinary protein excretion is not elevated.
interpretation.high: Proteinuria detected; may indicate glomerular or tubular kidney disease.
Glucose detected in urine (glucosuria). May indicate diabetes mellitus or renal glycosuria.

interpretation.low: Low morning cortisol. May indicate adrenal insufficiency or Addison disease.
interpretation.high: Elevated cortisol. May indicate Cushing syndrome, stress, or exogenous steroids.

interpretation.low: Low testosterone.
interpretation.high: Elevated testosterone. May indicate PCOS, adrenal disorders, or ovarian tumor.

interpretation.low: Low testosterone. May indicate hypogonadism, pituitary disorder, or aging.
interpretation.high: Elevated testosterone. May indicate androgen excess or exogenous use.

interpretation.low: Low estradiol. May indicate ovarian failure, menopause, or hypothalamic amenorrhea.
interpretation.high: Elevated estradiol. May indicate ovarian tumor, cirrhosis, or pregnancy.
interpretation.normal: Within normal limits (varies by cycle phase)

interpretation.low: Low estradiol.
interpretation.high: Elevated estradiol. May indicate gynecomastia, liver disease, or estrogen-producing tumor.

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. Prolactin level is appropriate.
interpretation.high: Hyperprolactinemia; may indicate pituitary adenoma, medication effect, or hypothyroidism.

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. Parathyroid hormone is appropriate.
interpretation.low: Low PTH; may indicate hypoparathyroidism or hypercalcemia-mediated suppression.
interpretation.high: Elevated PTH; may indicate primary hyperparathyroidism or secondary response to low calcium/vitamin D.

interpretation.low: Low reticulocyte count. May indicate bone marrow suppression or aplastic anemia.
interpretation.high: Elevated reticulocyte count. Indicates active red cell production; may indicate hemolysis or blood loss recovery.

interpretation.normal: Within normal limits. D-Dimer is below the standard threshold.
interpretation.high: Elevated D-Dimer; suggests fibrinolysis activation. Evaluate for VTE, DIC, or other causes.

interpretation.low: Below normal range
interpretation.high: Elevated CK. May indicate muscle injury, myocardial infarction, or rhabdomyolysis.

interpretation.low: Below normal range
interpretation.high: Elevated CK. May indicate muscle injury, myocardial infarction, or rhabdomyolysis.

interpretation.low: Low haptoglobin. May indicate intravascular hemolysis, liver disease, or hemolytic anemia.
interpretation.high: Elevated haptoglobin. May indicate acute inflammation or infection (acute phase reactant).

interpretation.low: Low ionized calcium. May indicate hypoparathyroidism, vitamin D deficiency, or alkalosis.
interpretation.high: Elevated ionized calcium. May indicate hyperparathyroidism or malignancy.

interpretation.low: Low C-peptide. May indicate type 1 diabetes or exogenous insulin use.
interpretation.high: Elevated C-peptide. May indicate type 2 diabetes, insulinoma, or insulin resistance.

interpretation.low: Low ceruloplasmin. May indicate Wilson disease or copper deficiency.
interpretation.high: Elevated ceruloplasmin. May indicate acute inflammation, pregnancy, or infection.

interpretation.low: Low prealbumin. May indicate malnutrition, liver disease, or chronic inflammation.
interpretation.high: Elevated prealbumin. May indicate renal dysfunction or steroid use.

interpretation.low: Low transferrin. May indicate chronic disease, liver dysfunction, or protein loss.
interpretation.high: Elevated transferrin. May indicate iron deficiency anemia.
Elevated calcitonin. May indicate medullary thyroid carcinoma or C-cell hyperplasia.
Elevated calcitonin. May indicate medullary thyroid carcinoma or C-cell hyperplasia.
Elevated procalcitonin. Strong marker for bacterial infection and sepsis.
interpretation.normal: Within normal limits; low probability of bacterial infection

interpretation.low: Low EPO. May indicate polycythemia vera or chronic kidney disease.
interpretation.high: Elevated EPO. May indicate secondary polycythemia, anemia response, or EPO-producing tumor.

interpretation.low: Low transferrin saturation. Indicates iron deficiency.
interpretation.high: Elevated transferrin saturation. May indicate iron overload or hemochromatosis.

interpretation.low: Low osmolality. May indicate overhydration, SIADH, or hyponatremia.
interpretation.high: Elevated osmolality. May indicate dehydration, hypernatremia, or diabetes insipidus.

interpretation.low: Low specific gravity. May indicate dilute urine, diabetes insipidus, or overhydration.
interpretation.high: Elevated specific gravity. May indicate dehydration, SIADH, or proteinuria.
Elevated RF. May indicate rheumatoid arthritis, Sjogren syndrome, or other autoimmune conditions.

interpretation.low: Below normal range
interpretation.high: Elevated B2M. May indicate kidney disease, multiple myeloma, or lymphoma.
Elevated CEA. May indicate colorectal cancer, other malignancies, or smoking.
Elevated CA-125. May indicate ovarian cancer, endometriosis, or pelvic inflammatory disease.
Elevated CA 19-9. May indicate pancreatic cancer, biliary tract disease, or other GI malignancies.

interpretation.low: Low C3. May indicate SLE, glomerulonephritis, or immune complex disease.
interpretation.high: Elevated C3. May indicate acute inflammation (acute phase reactant).

interpretation.low: Low C4. May indicate hereditary angioedema, SLE, or cryoglobulinemia.
interpretation.high: Elevated C4. May indicate acute inflammation.

interpretation.low: Low copper. May indicate copper deficiency, Menkes disease, or Wilson disease (with low ceruloplasmin).
interpretation.high: Elevated copper. May indicate Wilson disease (with low ceruloplasmin), inflammation, or pregnancy.

interpretation.low: Low zinc. May indicate zinc deficiency, malabsorption, or chronic disease.
interpretation.high: Elevated zinc. May indicate excessive supplementation.

interpretation.low: Low FSH. May indicate hypothalamic/pituitary dysfunction.
interpretation.high: Elevated FSH. May indicate primary ovarian insufficiency, perimenopause, or menopause.

interpretation.low: Low FSH. May indicate hypothalamic/pituitary dysfunction.
interpretation.high: Elevated FSH. May indicate primary testicular failure.

interpretation.low: Low DHEA-S. May indicate adrenal insufficiency.
interpretation.high: Elevated DHEA-S. May indicate PCOS, adrenal hyperplasia, or adrenal tumor.

interpretation.low: Low DHEA-S. May indicate adrenal insufficiency or aging.
interpretation.high: Elevated DHEA-S. May indicate adrenal hyperplasia or adrenal tumor.

interpretation.low: Low creatinine clearance. Indicates decreased kidney function.
interpretation.high: Elevated creatinine clearance. May indicate early diabetes or high cardiac output.

interpretation.low: Acidic urine. May indicate metabolic acidosis, high protein diet, or dehydration.
interpretation.high: Alkaline urine. May indicate urinary tract infection, renal tubular acidosis, or vegetarian diet.

interpretation.low: Below normal range
interpretation.high: Prolonged thrombin time. May indicate fibrinogen deficiency, DIC, or heparin effect.
Elevated LDL. Near optimal (100-129), Borderline high (130-159), High (160-189), Very high (≥190).

interpretation.low: May indicate bone marrow underproduction
interpretation.high: May indicate platelet activation or destruction

interpretation.low: Neutropenia; increased infection risk
interpretation.high: Neutrophilia; may indicate infection or inflammation

interpretation.low: Lymphopenia; may indicate viral infection or immune disorder
interpretation.high: Lymphocytosis; may indicate viral infection

interpretation.low: Within normal limits
interpretation.high: Monocytosis; may indicate chronic infection or inflammation

interpretation.low: Within normal limits
interpretation.high: Eosinophilia; may indicate allergy, parasitic infection, or autoimmune condition

interpretation.low: Within normal limits
interpretation.high: Basophilia; may indicate allergy or myeloproliferative disorder
